camel_example: aliyun das GetQueryOptimizeDataTop --region cn-hangzhou --Type RED --Time 1642953600000 --Engine MySQL
description_en: Returns the best- and worst-performing instances based on query governance data
description_zh: 调用GetQueryOptimizeDataTop接口，获取查询治理实例红榜和实例黑榜的数据
kebab_example: aliyun das get-query-optimize-data-top --engine MySQL --time 1642953600000 --type RED --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetQueryOptimizeDataTop

parameters.help_en:
The database engine. Valid values:

MySQL

PolarDBMySQL

PostgreSQL
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎，取值：

MySQL
PolarDBMySQL
PostgreSQL
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，多个实例ID用逗号分隔
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询数据的日期，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: time

parameters.help_en:
The type of instances that you want to query. Valid values:

RED: the best-performing instances

BLACK: the worst-performing instances
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的榜单类型：

RED：实例红榜。
BLACK：实例黑榜
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the instance resides. Valid values:

cn-china: Chinese mainland

cn-hongkong: China (Hong Kong)

ap-southeast-1: Singapore

This parameter takes effect only if InstanceIds is left empty. If you leave InstanceIds empty, the system obtains data from the region set by Region. By default, Region is set to cn-china. If you specify InstanceIds, Region does not take effect and the system obtains data from the region in which the first specified instance resides.\\

Set this parameter to cn-china for all your instances that reside in the regions in the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
实例所属地域，取值：

cn-china：中国内地。
cn-hongkong：中国香港。
ap-southeast-1：新加坡。

此参数只有在请求参数InstanceIds为空时有效。如果请求参数InstanceIds为空时，按照Region参数设置的地域获取数据，系统默认实例所属地域为cn-china；如果请求参数InstanceIds不为空时，即使设置了Region参数，也以InstanceIds所传入的第一个实例所在地域为准获取数据。

在中国内地各地域创建的实例，传入此参数时，都为cn-china
parameters.name: region

Type.description_en:
The metric name. Valid values:

sqlExecuteCount: the number of slow SQL executions.

optimizedSqlExecuteCount: the number of slow SQL executions that need to be optimized
Type.description_zh:
指标名：

sqlExecuteCount：慢SQL执行次数。
optimizedSqlExecuteCount：推荐优化的慢SQL执行次数

Total.description_en: The total number of entries returned

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
